# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 15
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 15

---

**15:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and to preach.

---

**The Gospel according to Mary.**

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* All three agents agree on the substance. EMET/LOGOS' rendering is adopted. The colophon is included per PNEUMA's note — it appears in P.Berol. 8502 and is part of the manuscript. The narrative ends without resolving the Peter-Mary tension, which is itself a significant literary and theological choice by the author.
